```{r w_normal}
plotly::plot_ly(x = 1:3, y = c(2, 1, 3), type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
```

```{r w_hide, results='hide'}
plotly::plot_ly(x = 1:3, y = c(3, 2, 1), type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
```

```{r w_include_false, include=FALSE}
plotly::plot_ly(x = 1:3, y = c(1, 3, 2), type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
```

```{r w_echo_false, echo=FALSE}
plotly::plot_ly(x = 1:3, y = c(2, 3, 1), type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
```
